name: feature.comments.nodes
description: Comments feature node pack — read/post/resolve nodes over the ctx.features.comments surface. list reads a resource thread; post adds an (agent-authored) comment to a commentable resource; resolve marks a comment resolved. Tenant-guarded; the post emits a tenant-scoped notification through the existing seam.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Comments: List Thread
nodes.description: Lists a resource's comment thread over ctx.features.comments. Tenant-guarded.

nodes.label: Comments: Post
nodes.description: Posts a comment (or reply, via parentId) on a commentable resource (cms_page | kb_collection | chat_message | priority_idea | canvas_document | canvas_slides | creative_brief) over ctx.features.comments. The resource is validated in-org. Side-effecting: it mints a durable row and emits an addressed, user-visible notification, so a replay/fork is served the recorded outcome rather than posting a second time.

nodes.label: Comments: Resolve
nodes.description: Marks a comment resolved over ctx.features.comments, stamping resolvedBy (the agent) and resolvedOnBehalfOf (the run's human). Side-effecting since ADR 0881: a real open-to-resolved transition notifies the comment's author and emits host.comments.comment.resolved, so a replay/fork is served the recorded outcome rather than resolving again.
